title: Why GitHub Actions Is Used knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Why GitHub Actions Is Used?
options: Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Teams use GitHub Actions to automate repeatable checks and releases, expose failures early, and attach a clear status to code changes.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
questions.answer_key: Teams use GitHub Actions to automate repeatable checks and releases, expose failures early, and attach a clear status to code changes.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of why github actions is used: Teams use GitHub Actions to automate repeatable checks and releases, expose failures early, and attach a clear status to code changes. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to why github actions is used?
options: Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence. For this lesson, consider: Teams use GitHub Actions to automate repeatable checks and releases, expose failures early, and attach a clear status to code changes.
